video.title: Do You Need Motivation to Start?

elements.content: Disciplined people may not be using more willpower.
The feeling shows up late, or never, and the task stays untouched.
A 2015 paper ran six studies with 2,274 people in total.
and reported less effort holding themselves back.
A practical way to try this.
One: pick a fixed cue, like right after breakfast.
Two: shrink the task to two minutes.
Three: start the moment the cue happens.
These results were linked, not proven, and mostly self-reported.
Try it today: pick one cue, and do two minutes after it.
